[Unit]
Description=AW test-serving CANDIDATE (aw_e8, candidate533 weights) on the build box
Documentation=file:///srv/aw-serve/app/authoritative-web-app/587-test-serving.md
After=docker.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/srv/aw-serve/app/authoritative-web-app
# Same prod-env base as the twin unit, plus the candidate's dense-rescore
# policy (256-dim rescore, 3x oversampling) and the candidate533 fusion
# weights file, tracked at cytir/serve/fusion_weights.candidate533.json
# in THIS checkout — matches the old orchestration box's historical port-8399 command (task 516)
# byte-for-byte. A weights swap here is a file-path change to a tracked,
# versioned artifact, never an edit to weights in place.
ExecStart=/srv/aw-serve/venv/bin/python \
    cytir/ops/prod_env_run.py \
    --collection aw_e8 \
    --qdrant-url http://localhost:6457 \
    --mrl-dim 256 \
    --tei-url http://localhost:8899 \
    --extra AW_DENSE_RESCORE=1 \
    --extra AW_DENSE_OVERSAMPLING=3.0 \
    --extra AW_FUSION_WEIGHTS=/srv/aw-serve/app/authoritative-web-app/cytir/serve/fusion_weights.candidate533.json \
    --extra AW_QDRANT_TIMEOUT=60 \
    --extra AW_WEBAPP=/srv/aw-serve/app/authoritative-web-app/webapp/index.html \
    -- /srv/aw-serve/venv/bin/python -m uvicorn cytir.serve.app:api --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8399
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
User=root

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
